# Bashies Biltong & Deli

> Family-owned biltong shop and deli in Plumstead, Cape Town, South Africa. Bashies makes authentic South African biltong, droëwors and premium game meats, naturally air-dried using traditional methods, and sells them from its store on Wicklow Rd.

Key facts:

- Business type: biltong shop and deli (South African dried meats)
- Address: Wicklow Rd, Plumstead, Cape Town, 7800, Western Cape, South Africa
- Phone: +27 66 120 9331 (also on WhatsApp: https://wa.me/27661209331)
- Email: hello@bashies.co.za
- Trading hours (SAST): Monday–Friday 09:00–18:00, Saturday 09:00–17:00, Sunday 09:00–14:00
- Website: https://bashies.co.za
- Online shop: https://shop.bashies.co.za/collections/all

## Products

- Traditional Biltong: authentic South African beef biltong, expertly seasoned and naturally air-dried to tender perfection.
- Chilli Biltong: beef biltong with a bold, fiery chilli spice.
- Beef Droëwors: premium lean beef dry sausage, expertly spiced and air-dried; rich and savoury.
- Cherry Chilli Droëwors: droëwors combining fruity cherry sweetness with a spicy kick.
- Geelvet Picanha Beef: premium picanha (rump cap) with rich marbling, air-dried to a tender, juicy finish.
- Game Biltong: lean, intensely flavoured biltong made from game meat such as kudu.

Customer reviews on the site also mention Wagyu beef biltong, fatty beef biltong, Wagyu burgers, nuts and dried-fruit snacks available in store.

## About

- The name Bashies blends the names of the owners' children, Ashleigh and Sebastian.
- Founded by Tina and Rowan, who started in 2020 from their garage during lockdown, making high-protein lifestyle products and premium meats.
- From July 2022 Bashies traded at local Cape Town markets.
- The first Bashies store opened in July 2023 in Plumstead.
